description: This file defines utilities and functions for handling named tensors in PyTorch, including name propagation, inference, and conversion between dimension names and indices.

classes.name: NameVector
classes.description: Type alias for a small vector of Dimname objects used for name handling.

methods.name: has_names
methods.description: Checks if any tensor in the list has names.

methods.name: dimname_to_position
methods.description: Converts a Dimname to its positional index in a tensor.

methods.name: dimnames_to_positions
methods.description: Converts a list of Dimnames to their respective positions in a tensor.

methods.name: unify_from_right
methods.description: Unifies two DimnameLists from the right, used for name inference in broadcasting.

methods.name: reportNYIDimnameOverload
methods.description: Reports an error when a dimname overload is used improperly.

methods.name: propagate_names_if_present_and_nonempty
methods.description: Propagates names to a tensor if they are present and non-empty.

methods.name: propagate_names_if_nonempty
methods.description: Propagates names to a tensor if they are non-empty.

methods.name: propagate_names
methods.description: Propagates specified names to a tensor.

methods.name: propagate_names
methods.description: Copies all names from source tensor to result tensor.

methods.name: propagate_names_except
methods.description: Propagates all names except those at specified indices.

methods.name: propagate_names_for_reduction
methods.description: Propagates names for reduction operations, considering keepdim.

methods.name: propagate_names_for_expand
methods.description: Propagates names during tensor expansion.

methods.name: compute_cat_outnames
methods.description: Computes output names for concatenation.

methods.name: compute_broadcast_outnames
methods.description: Computes output names for broadcasting.

methods.name: broadcast_to_outnames
methods.description: Computes broadcasted output names given a reference tensor.

methods.name: compute_matmul_outnames
methods.description: Computes output names for matrix multiplication.

methods.name: compute_cdist_outnames
methods.description: Computes output names for cdist operation.

methods.name: compute_bmm_outnames
methods.description: Computes output names for batch matrix multiplication.

methods.name: compute_squeeze_outnames
methods.description: Computes output names after squeeze operation.

methods.name: compute_diagonal_outnames
methods.description: Computes output names for diagonal extraction.

methods.name: propagate_names_if_nonempty
methods.description: Overload for propagating names to TensorImpl* if non-empty.

methods.name: propagate_names
methods.description: Overload for propagating names to TensorImpl*.

methods.name: propagate_names
methods.description: Inline function to propagate names between TensorBase objects.

methods.name: propagate_names_if_nonempty
methods.description: Inline function to propagate names if non-empty between TensorBase objects.

methods.name: propagate_names_for_addmm
methods.description: Computes output names for addmm operation.

methods.name: propagate_names_for_addmv
methods.description: Computes output names for addmv operation.

methods.name: check_names_for_dot
methods.description: Checks if two vectors have matching names for dot product.

methods.name: compute_baddbmm_outnames
methods.description: Computes output names for baddbmm operation.

methods.name: are_names_equal
methods.description: Checks if two TensorImpl objects have equal names.
